channel.description: What changed in AI, ML, forward-deployed and Python job postings this week.

item.title: Skills market, week of 2026-11-18
item.description:
• 20,415 live tech postings in the last 30 days (+2,603 since 2026-11-18).
  • Biggest moves since last week: Financial services / banking domain 5% (−27.6 pp), Python 14% (−27.5 pp), Observability / tracing / monitoring 7% (−26.7 pp).
  • Rising over 90 days: AWS (+11.6 pp), Java / Kotlin (Spring) (+9.3 pp), System design / architecture (+8.3 pp).
  • New on the radar: HTML5 (39 companies), MVC (35 companies), EDA (31 companies), JSON (31 companies).
  • Hiring more: Amazon (+1292), Shield AI (+213), OpenAI (+113).
  • Median advertised pay in SG: SGD 90,000 a year, from 1,912 ads.
  • Median advertised pay in US: USD 220,000 a year, from 6,804 ads.
